warwick_edith.title: First women join largest AI assisted breast screening trial
warwick_edith.snippet: First women join largest AI assisted breast screening trial Skip to main content Skip to navigation Sign in Study Research Business Alumni News Engagement Search Warwick Search News Latest News First women join world’s largest AI assisted breast screening trial Expert Comment Get In Touch Press Office FAQs Latest News First women join world’s largest AI assisted breast screening trial First women join world’s largest AI assisted breast screening trial Hundreds of women are now being invited to the Warwick-led EDITH trial, the world’s largest artificial intelligence (AI) assisted breast screening trial, which could transform breast cancer diagnosis. Breast cancer is the most common cancer in women, with around 55,000 cases diagnosed in the UK every year. Around 2.2 million women in the UK have breast screening each year, and all women aged 50 to 71 are invited every three years. Over the next three years, nearly 700,000 women attending routine NHS breast screening will be invited to take part in the EDITH trial , which will test whether AI-assisted tools can improve early cancer detection and enabling specialist clinicians to spend more time supporting people with cancer.
